function: An element's padding-inline-end is the space from its border to its content, at the end in the inline direction.

defaults.Animatable: yes. Read about animatable Try it

values.function: Default. The element's default padding-inline-end distance.
Specifies distance in px, pt, cm, etc. Negative values are not allowed. Read about length units
Specifies distance in percent relative to size of parent element in the inline direction.
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
Inherits this property from its parent element. Read about inherit
